page_title: WHU 0-2 FUL | West Ham v Fulham 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Lukasz Fabianski easily deals with the threat.
90+8' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Joao Palhinha and he is replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
90+7' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
90+6' Good clearance! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
90+5' The corner from Emerson (West Ham) is cleared away by the defence.
90+2' That will be all from Rodrigo Muniz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Armando Broja (Fulham).
90+2' The substitution is prepared. Adama Traore (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Willian.
90+1' David Moyes is forced to make a change. George Earthy (West Ham) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Maxwel Cornet.
90' We will have 11 min. of added time.
86' The game is interrupted. George Earthy (West Ham) suffers a horrific injury!
85' Emerson (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
84' Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. West Ham win a corner kick.
83' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michail Antonio departs the field of play to be replaced by George Earthy (West Ham).
81' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
80' Emerson (West Ham) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
80' Harry Wilson (Fulham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. West Ham will take a free kick near the side line.

76' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball from hitting the net. What a save!
74' Substitution. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) makes his way off the pitch and Bobby De Cordova-Reid comes on as his replacement.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harry Wilson replaces Alex Iwobi (Fulham).

72' 0 - 2 GOAL! Alex Iwobi finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Andreas Pereira (Fulham), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 0:2.
72' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
69' David Moyes prepares a substitution. Vladimir Coufal is replaced by Benjamin Johnson (West Ham).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and James Ward-Prowse trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tomas Soucek (West Ham).
69' Unbelievable miss! Danny Ings (West Ham) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
69' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
69' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
66' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Fabianski, who smothers the ball.
64' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
63' Corner kick. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
61' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Konstantinos Mavropanos walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kurt Zouma (West Ham).
58' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
58' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. West Ham earn a corner.
57' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

57' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Lukasz Fabianski leaps like a salmon to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
55' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
55' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
54' The ball is cleared after Andreas Pereira (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
50' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Mohammed Kudus, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
50' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Joao Palhinha (Fulham). Stuart Attwell saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
47' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Lukasz Fabianski is alert and denies him.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Stuart Attwell has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' A clever short pass gives Alex Iwobi (Fulham) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
44' Danny Ings (West Ham) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
44' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
43' A nice individual effort by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. It will be a corner kick for West Ham.

41' That didn't go as planned! Andreas Pereira (Fulham) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Lukasz Fabianski, who easily kept it out.
39' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
39' Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
38' Great save! Willian (Fulham) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Lukasz Fabianski.
37' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

35' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Joao Palhinha (Fulham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
32' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
32' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
31' It's a nice effort by Andreas Pereira (Fulham) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Lukasz Fabianski. Easy save.
28' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Lucas Paqueta (West Ham). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
27' Willian (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' Willian (Fulham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
24' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
22' Stuart Attwell blows the whistle, Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is penalised for a foul.

19' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
17' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Lukasz Fabianski is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
16' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Bernd Leno has no trouble gathering it.
14' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) latches onto a short pass from Willian inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Andreas Pereira (Fulham) and he fired home from close range. The score is 0:1.
9' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

8' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
8' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
7' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. West Ham have a corner.
7' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. It's a free kick to West Ham in a dangerous position.
5' That's unlucky! Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
5' West Ham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

5' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play and West Ham manage to earn a corner.
4' Michail Antonio (West Ham) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
4' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) meets a cross inside the box, but Bernd Leno wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
2' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and West Ham will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
